findings.title: Secrets store binding uses binding name as secret_name, binding the wrong secret.
findings.body: The Cloudflare `secrets_store` binding binds one secret, `secret_name`, from the store. Here `secret_name` is set to the worker binding name (e.g. `SECRETS`), which is usually not a secret in the store. The documented usage `env.SECRETS.get("API_KEY")` also does not fit this API, so bound workers fail at runtime. Emit one binding per secret in `binding.secrets`, or require the caller to give the secret name explicitly.

findings.title: Calling `bind` in the deploy-time resource function breaks outside the worker runtime.
findings.body: `SecretsStore` always calls `bind(store)` and reads `binding.get`. Other resources only expose runtime bindings when running inside a worker. Unless `bind` is a no-op outside that runtime, this throws during normal deploys. Guard the call the way the other bound resources do.

findings.title: Removing the describe-block prefix from scope names makes same-named tests collide.
findings.body: Test scopes are now keyed only by `testName`. Tests with the same name in different `describe` blocks of one file now share the same scope and state, so they can interfere with each other. This change has nothing to do with the secrets store feature; restore the `ctx.task.suite.name` prefix.
